title: Lion and Little Bunny
lesson: Even small friends can help, and kindness comes back
summary: Big Lion is kind to tiny Bunny, then Bunny helps Lion get his golden crown down from a tree.

steps.say: Once upon a time, a big lion walked in the forest.
Lion was big, but he was very kind.
Look! A little bunny was lost and sad.

steps.text: Oh no. I am so small. I cannot find home.
Roar, do not worry. I will help you.

steps.say: Lion walked with Bunny. Step, step, step.
Soon Bunny saw her house. Hooray!

steps.text: Thank you, Lion! Someday I will help you too.
Roar! You are small, but you are kind.

steps.say: The next day, the wind blew. Whoosh!
Lion's golden crown flew up into a tall tree.

steps.text: Roar! My crown is stuck. I am too big.
Quack! I cannot reach it. I cannot fly.

steps.say: Then, hop, hop, hop! Here came Bunny.

steps.text: Hello, Lion! Now I can help you.

steps.say: Little Bunny hopped up, up, up the tree.

steps.text: Hop, hop! I got your crown.
Roar! Thank you, Bunny. You are a good friend.
Quack! Small friends can do big things.

steps.say: Kind friends help each other. The end!
